title: Free Halloween in South Florida 2026

scenes.text: You don't need to spend a dollar this Halloween. Here's what's free in South Florida.
scenes.caption: You don't need to spend a dollar this Halloween. Here's what's free in South Florida.

scenes.text: Start October seventeenth in Fort Lauderdale. Christ Church throws a free trunk or treat on its field off Commercial Boulevard, from five to seven thirty.
scenes.caption: Start Oct. 17 in Fort Lauderdale. Christ Church throws a free trunk-or-treat on its field off Commercial Boulevard, from 5 to 7:30 p.m.

scenes.text: On October twenty third, the Moss Center in Cutler Bay throws a free Halloween night, with a spooky symphony, treats, and costumes. Tickets are free, but reserve them early.
scenes.caption: On Oct. 23, the Moss Center in Cutler Bay throws a free Halloween night, with a spooky symphony, treats, and costumes. Tickets are free, but reserve them early.
scenes.sub: Cutler Bay · 6–9 p.m. · reserve free tickets

scenes.text: October twenty ninth, Miami Dade College in Hialeah turns into a free Halloween party, with a haunted house, trick or treating, and giveaways, from four to eight.
scenes.caption: Oct. 29, Miami Dade College in Hialeah turns into a free Halloween party, with a haunted house, trick-or-treating, and giveaways, from 4 to 8 p.m.

scenes.text: On Halloween night, Lincoln Road becomes one giant free block party. Kids trick or treat from five to seven, then the party runs until one a.m. More than fifty thousand people usually show up.
scenes.caption: On Halloween night, Lincoln Road becomes one giant free block party. Kids trick-or-treat from 5 to 7, then the party runs until 1 a.m. More than 50,000 people usually show up.

scenes.text: And for the adults, Hallo Win takes over Wynwood Marketplace the same night. It's free, with D J's and a whole costume crowd.
scenes.caption: And for the adults, HalloWYN takes over Wynwood Marketplace the same night. It's free, with DJs and a whole costume crowd.

scenes.text: Halloween is the one night all of Miami is out in costume, so you never really know who you just walked past, and that's the part NEAR is for. Tag who you're going with.
scenes.caption: Halloween is the one night all of Miami is out in costume, so you never really know who you just walked past, and that's the part NEAR is for. Tag who you're going with.

igCaption:
You don't need to spend a dollar this Halloween 🎃 Free in South Florida:

Oct 17: Trunk-or-treat at Christ Church, Fort Lauderdale (5–7:30pm)
Oct 23: Halloween at the Moss Center, Cutler Bay (6–9pm, reserve free tickets)
Oct 29: Halloween party + haunted house at MDC Hialeah Campus (4–8pm)
Oct 31: Lincoln Road block party, Miami Beach (kids 5–7pm, party till 1am)
Oct 31: HalloWYN at Wynwood Marketplace (free)

Tag who you're going with 👻

#MiamiHalloween #SouthFlorida #MiamiEvents #FreeThingsToDo
sources: Mommy Poppins: Halloween at The Moss Center, Oct 23 2026, 6–9pm, 10950 SW 211 St, free tickets reserved in advance

South Florida on the Cheap: Christ Church Trunk or Treat, Sat Oct 17 2026, 5–7:30pm, Christ Church Field, Commercial Blvd & 24th Terrace, free
